title: PAR-134/7Q DBCOLOR CMC method fail-closed read/write coverage
scope: Preserve CMC method identity in the DRW_DbColor typed parser for its supported C0-C3 model
Refuse unsupported or unknown explicit DBCOLOR CMC methods instead of normalizing them to a supported color
Add parser-level generated positive and fail-closed controls to the existing focused object-vector selector

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaDwgSpecification.finding: R2004+ CMC is encoded as a reserved BS index, method-packed BL, and RC flags for optional TV color/book names.
odaDwgSpecification.limit: The cited generic CMC envelope does not define semantic payload layouts for every AcCmColor method in the narrower DRW_DbColor class.

localSource.finding: DRW_DbColor exposes C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C2 RGB, and C3 indexed color. The generic CMC reader returns a ByLayer-shaped fallback for other method bytes, while this class cannot faithfully represent those methods.

generatedControls.positive: AC1024 complete object frames use the production writer for C0-C3 and assert exact parsed method, color value, handle, and applicable names. The current writer emits optional names only on C2 RGB.
generatedControls.negative: AC1024 literal generic CMC envelopes exercise C4-C8 and unknown C9 and assert typed parse refusal, bad input state, and reset of preexisting typed values.
generatedControls.limit: Unsupported-method controls test bounded refusal at the generic BS/packed-BL/RC envelope only; they do not assert or infer those methods' class-specific payload grammar.

changes.productionSummary: DRW_DbColor::parseDwg now captures and validates the CMC method, preserves C0-C3 method identity, and fails closed for unsupported methods. DRW_DbColor::encodeDwg refuses explicitly specified nonzero methods outside C0-C3 while retaining the preexisting method-absent inference path.
generatedTests: Extended DbColorCodecProbe to expose parseDwg without changing public API or ABI.
Added full AC1024 DBCOLOR frame coverage for C0-C3 parsed values and optional RGB name/book values.
Added unsupported-method refusal/reset coverage for C4-C8 and C9, alongside existing encode refusal and supported writer controls.

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: DBCOLOR no longer publishes unsupported CMC method bytes as ByLayer; supported C0-C3 values retain their method identity in generated AC1024 controls.
unresolved: CMC methods outside C0-C3 need consumer-specific payload/semantic evidence before typed support is implemented.
The generic getCmColor caller inventory and cross-consumer compatibility audit remain open.
Independent producer, native CAD, and broad external semantic qualification remain separate gates.
assessment.nextAction: Self-unblock to the existing PAR-03/PAR-04 code/context audit, beginning with a bounded CMC consumer census and the established DXF group-code profile rows; if no further method correction is supported, continue another locally evidenced parity item.
